verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an AI agent and automation platform like Gumloop. However, the evidence pack never documents batch processing, loop or list modes, or acting on many items in one operation. The Code Sandbox, triggers, and approvals for deleting records are adjacent features or building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
